protocol.frozen: Stage03 gaze, per-capture keystone, framewise P1 magnification, common reference and postfit slope.
protocol.frame_parameter: A only; no P4 magnification, rotation, smoothing or radius normalization in fitting.
protocol.objective: Equal-fixation mean of mean-three-vertex squared inverse reference distances + equal-fixation mean of ((mean A - expected A)/anchor_width)^2 * residual_scale^2.
protocol.anchor_mean: Arithmetic mean over complete frames in each of the 20 fixation periods.
protocol.inverse_domain: Per-frame upper bound reduced only to keep the monotone inverse branch; no complete frame discarded.
protocol.expected_A: Nominal capture demand, not framewise accommodation ground truth.
protocol.comparison: Stage03 capture-constant κ and frozen-law nominal A, each scored on common valid frames.
